title: 第一家店開了，做法開始有了主人

data.prompt: Wide shot at a compact late-1950s Japanese sushi shop entrance, one generic shopkeeper lifting the plain doorway curtain to reveal a tight counter and moving plates, mild morning light.

lines.text: 一九五八年四月，近鐵布施站附近，第一家「廻る元禄寿司」開門。

data.prompt: Wide shot of a compact 1958 counter-only restaurant near Fuse Station, one seated customer smiling as she takes a plate from the moving belt, the tight ring of stools showing the small scale, soft daylight from the entrance.

和眼前這家迴轉店，

lines.text: 是不同時間、不同賣法；現在，壽司放上帶子，客人看中哪盤，就自己拿起來。

data.prompt: Wide shot from the pavement outside a late-1950s Osaka restaurant, one passerby stopping at a broad plain window to watch a plate travel past inside, blank storefront sign above him, soft afternoon street light.

lines.text: 輸送帶的運轉，從店外就看得見。路過的人停下腳步，好奇那一圈壽司會怎麼轉。

data.prompt: Medium shot behind a 1958 Osaka moving-belt counter, one chef releasing a prepared plate onto the moving belt and watching it leave his hand, his relieved face above the worktop, gentle light from the shop window.

lines.text: 店員仍得工作；改掉的是握好以後，非得由人逐盤送到座位的那一段。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a circa-1960 Japanese restaurant office, one anonymous shop operator studying a simple unmarked drawing of a circulating counter with a concerned expression, a glimpse of ordinary street shops through the window, muted daylight.

lines.text: 店開了，別人也看得見做法。

data.prompt: Wide shot in an Osaka shopping lane during a later expansion period, one worker raising the shutter of another plain restaurant frontage, the curved counter just visible within, neighboring shop signs left blank, soft morning light.

lines.text: 白石後來在大阪道頓堀展店。

data.prompt: Medium shot in a 1960s Japanese records office, one generic clerk sliding a blank utility-model folder into a separate archive drawer, no lettering or seals, gentle desk-lamp light.

lines.text: 一九六二年，白石名下有一件「附輸送帶的料理台」實用新案登記。

data.prompt: Close-up at a 1960s Japanese engineering desk, one technician pointing to a simple blank diagram of a conveyor built into a counter while a separate serving dish sits outside the paper, the device drawing lit by a desk lamp.

lines.text: 它談的是裝置的做法，不是把壽司這道料理變成誰的專屬品。

data.prompt: Wide shot inside a 1960s Japanese legal office, one office professional placing a closed unmarked warning envelope beside a simplified conveyor-table sketch, rows of plain folders behind, subdued daylight from a high window.

lines.text: 元祿壽司對相似的店發出過警告。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a late-1960s Japanese office desk, one generic restaurant manager laying a plain warning letter beside an unmarked conveyor sketch, soft side light, no legible writing.

lines.text: J-Net21 報導，它在東京和大阪請律師與專利代理人處理這件事。

lines.text: 這些警告能讓人看見當時品牌如何保護自己的做法，

lines.text: 另一件更直接的事，還在前方：讓沒走過大阪街頭的人，也親眼看到這條會送壽司的路。

lines.text: 把店開在會場單軌列車西口站前。剛開始客人逐漸來，後來變成長隊。

lines.text: 放上輸送帶。白石與員工清早出門，常過午夜才回家。

data.prompt: Close-up in a generic 1970 exhibition kitchen, one anonymous worker peeling shrimp beside plain seaweed sheets and a wooden sushi tub before serving, soft pavilion light, no readable text.

lines.text: 白石的兒子博志後來回憶，光是剝蝦殼、剪海苔就忙個不停。

data.prompt: Wide shot behind a 1970 exhibition food counter, one tired kitchen worker checking a row of prepared plain tubs before the next crowd arrives, a focused face, diffuse ceiling light.

lines.text: 曾靠機器省掉逐盤手遞的店，到了萬博，壽司仍得由人先備好。

data.prompt: Wide shot at an unbranded 1970 exhibition sushi counter, one anonymous worker placing a filled wooden tub on a conveyor while a line of guests approaches in the distance, human preparation remains visible behind the belt, soft pavilion light.

lines.text: 這跟首店五十日圓一盤不同；同一條送餐線，這次要面對的是一波又一波的客流。
